Tick what works, leave unticked what doesn't, and describe problems below.

- [ ] The app installs; the launcher tile shows the icon and title
- [ ] It fills the whole screen, with no cropping or blur
- [ ] Setup works: IP and login typed with the on-screen keyboard; Back leaves the keyboard
- [ ] The language follows the TV menu language
- [ ] Arrows, OK and Back work on every screen; Back at Home asks to exit and Exit closes the app
- [ ] Holding OK on an item opens its menu, and the next dialog is not confirmed by the same hold
- [ ] Colour keys and Play, Pause, Stop, FF and RW work in the player
- [ ] A 1080p H.264 MKV plays, resumes where you left off, seeks and saves progress
- [ ] A 4K HEVC MKV plays (webOS 5 and newer)
- [ ] The audio track list opens and switching works (Green)
- [ ] The subtitle list opens and switching works (Yellow)
- [ ] Pressing Home during playback and reopening the app shows the player paused; Play resumes
- [ ] Elementum dialogs and notifications appear
- [ ] Long rows and grids scroll smoothly (webOS 4.x)
- [ ] Magic Remote: hovering focuses buttons, sidebar and fields; posters and list rows show a grey ring;
      click presses
- [ ] Pointing at a poster that is not focused and pressing OK opens the poster you point at (if not: which one opened?)
- [ ] Holding OK with the pointer visible opens the item menu, and letting go does not also open the item
- [ ] After pressing an arrow key (pointer hides), no poster keeps a stale grey ring
- [ ] Resting the pointer on a sidebar entry switches the tab after a short moment; is that OK or annoying?
